findings.title: Hardcoded credential committed to source control
findings.description: A string matching the PSP webhook secret pattern (whsec_*) is present in version-controlled source. Secrets in source control are readable by anyone with repository access and persist in git history after removal.
findings.remediation: Rotate the credential and load it from the secrets manager at runtime.

findings.title: SQL injection via string interpolation
findings.description: User-controlled input from req.query.filter is interpolated directly into a SQL statement. Rated HIGH rather than CRITICAL: the finding sits on an authenticated route under /v1/reports, so exploitation requires valid merchant credentials.
findings.remediation: Use parameterised queries or an allowlist of sortable/filterable columns.

findings.title: Missing object-level authorization check
findings.description: A record is retrieved by an identifier taken from the request path and returned to the caller without comparing the record's owner against the authenticated principal.
findings.remediation: Add an ownership predicate to the query or reject on mismatch.

findings.title: Potentially sensitive object written to log output
findings.description: An object reaching a logging call may contain sensitive fields. The logger configures redaction for 'password' and the authorization header, which mitigates the common cases.
findings.remediation: Extend the logger redaction list if the object carries sensitive fields.

findings.title: Non-constant-time comparison of message authentication code
findings.description: An HMAC digest is compared with the JavaScript strict inequality operator, which short-circuits on the first differing byte. An attacker able to submit many requests may recover a valid signature by measuring response latency.
findings.remediation: Compare digests with crypto.timingSafeEqual on equal-length buffers.

findings.title: OS command built from interpolated input
findings.description: A shell command is constructed by interpolating a value into a template literal and executed via child_process.execSync. If the interpolated value is attacker-influenced, arbitrary commands run with the privileges of the process.
findings.remediation: Use execFile with an argument array, or validate the input against a strict pattern.

findings.title: Credential literal used as configuration fallback
findings.description: A credential-shaped literal is used as the default when the environment variable is absent. Rated MEDIUM: deployed environments are expected to supply the variable.
findings.remediation: Fail closed at startup when a required secret is missing.

findings.title: Express configured to trust proxy headers
findings.description: The application is configured to derive req.ip from the X-Forwarded-For header without restricting which proxies are trusted. This is a common and usually intentional configuration for services behind a load balancer.
findings.remediation: Set trust proxy to the specific number of proxy hops in front of the application.

findings.title: Prototype pollution in lodash
findings.description: Versions of lodash before 4.17.21 are vulnerable to prototype pollution via the zipObjectDeep, set and setWith functions. A crafted property path can modify Object.prototype and change application behaviour globally.

findings.title: Arbitrary code execution in jest test runner dependency chain
findings.description: The resolved dependency chain for jest 26.x includes a package version with a published arbitrary code execution advisory. Any process that loads the affected module may be compromised.

findings.title: Server-side request forgery in axios
findings.description: axios 0.25.0 follows redirects to arbitrary hosts and forwards the original request headers, allowing an attacker who controls a redirect target to receive credentials intended for another origin.

findings.title: Unsafe deserialization in js-yaml
findings.description: js-yaml before 3.13.1 permits instantiation of arbitrary objects when loading untrusted YAML with the default schema, leading to code execution.
findings.remediation: Upgrade js-yaml and use safeLoad for untrusted input.

findings.title: Outdated express release with published advisories
findings.description: The declared express version is several minor releases behind the current 4.x line and is affected by an open redirect advisory in the response redirect helper.

findings.title: Dependency resolved from a non-default registry host
findings.description: A lockfile entry resolves to a host other than registry.npmjs.org. This is common in organisations that operate an internal mirror or proxy and is reported for inventory purposes.
findings.remediation: Confirm the registry host is an approved mirror.
